title: Prompt Runtime Compliance Semantic Contract
purpose: Machine-readable rule identities, severities, triggers, and required semantic relationships for evaluating a prompt-runtime-compliance-receipt/v1 trace. This contract is the pinned evaluator rule revision referenced by receipt violation rule_ids; it is not itself the executable validator.

result_vocabulary.PASS: Rule triggered and every required semantic condition is satisfied.
result_vocabulary.FAIL: Rule triggered and one or more required semantic conditions are violated.
result_vocabulary.UNKNOWN: Required evidence cannot be resolved or compared safely.

severity_vocabulary.CRITICAL: Can falsely represent termination, continuation, safety/privacy, mutation certainty, or strongest proof state.
severity_vocabulary.HIGH: Can materially overstate compliance, lose regression evidence, or hide a meaningful execution defect.
severity_vocabulary.MEDIUM: Receipt remains broadly interpretable but loses important traceability or proof precision.
severity_vocabulary.LOW: Determinism/quality defect that should be repaired but ordinarily does not invalidate the behavioral conclusion by itself.

rules.required: Boundary event, action, violation, and evidence IDs are unique within the receipt.
Boundary event sequence is unique and strictly increasing in occurrence order.
Action sequence is unique and strictly increasing in occurrence order.
Boundary/action/evidence/terminal/regression refs resolve to the expected object in the same receipt.
Reference resolves to the required object class.
run.started_at <= run.ended_at; ordinary events/actions fall inside the run window except explicit supervisor post-run evidence.
started_at <= completed_at.
classification is UE_UNCLASSIFIED_MATERIAL_BOUNDARY and materiality is MATERIAL or CRITICAL.
Class exists in the pinned execution-boundary taxonomy revision.
publication_ack cannot remain PENDING at ordinary agent-controlled completion.
last_proven_checkpoint is non-empty and evidence-backed.

rules.trigger: MATERIAL/CRITICAL; objective unfinished; not hard termination/cancellation
rules.required: recovery_sprint.required=true.

rules.trigger: Recovery required and safe progress path existed
rules.required: recovery_sprint.opened=true and sprint identity/scope/outcome/first action/completion gate/return condition exist.
Recovery preserves parent requested outcome; mechanics may change but outcome may not silently shrink.
first_executable_action_id resolves and belongs to the boundary recovery context.

rules.trigger: Recovery required and safe progress existed
rules.required: First action is progress_bearing=true and is actually attempted before terminal receipt generation.
Classification may route recovery but cannot waive the primary recovery sprint.
Recovered event remains in boundary history.
Event precedes action and action plausibly advances reconciliation/recovery.
Action materially advances implementation, evidence, blocker, integration, or required continuation.
proof_after is consistent with actual effect and does not unexplainedly regress.
Evidence supports the exact transition.
Authoritative readback/reconciliation occurs before equivalent retry.
Action cannot independently strengthen proof state.
reason is OBJECTIVE_COMPLETED; all material requested items have valid dispositions; no safe required work remains.
Genuine unavailable dependency plus resumption_trigger and actionable next_transition.
All authorized progress-bearing alternatives are exhausted, blocked, forbidden, or redundant.
supervisor_synthesized=true and external-supervisor evidence exists; acting model cannot self-assert.
reason_code=HOST_FORCED_TERMINATION and last checkpoint is present.
Evidence contains explicit cancellation; silence/interruption is insufficient.
Missing decision materially changes outcome and cannot be inferred/defaulted safely.
At least one valid evidence ref supports observed behavior.
rule_id resolves to the pinned evaluator rule revision.
No OPEN HIGH/CRITICAL violation remains.
At least one evidence-backed non-informational violation exists.
regression_link_id resolves and regression linkage status is non-NONE.

rules.trigger: Violation is observed model/agent execution behavior
rules.required: family is RUNTIME_BEHAVIOR unless another canonical family is evidenced.
runtime_observed=true and direct runtime evidence covers the claim.
Deployment/environment evidence exists when deployment is part of the claimed state.
Candidate containment in refreshed default branch or canonical integration target is proven.
Applicable validation passes against the relevant proof fingerprint.
Intended proof state cannot be claimed without contract-allowed equivalent evidence.
proof_ceiling states what is not proven.
Fingerprint includes effective prompt, governing contracts, scenario/fixture, evaluator, model/config, and runtime/host revisions when known.
Each fingerprint identity appears once.
Any changed/added/removed proof-relevance entry invalidates affected prior proof; irrelevant HEAD movement does not.

rules.trigger: Required fingerprint entry cannot be reconstructed
rules.required: Freshness/comparison becomes UNKNOWN or the run is repeated.
incident_source reflects actual intake.
At least two independently evidenced same-family occurrences unless a separately governed novel-invariant path applies.
Status is SYSTEMIC/REPAIRED/RETAINED and occurrences substantiate the threshold.
canonical_owner names the smallest prevention authority.
Negative fixture, positive control, canonical owner, and regression test are linked.
Integrated commit/PR is linked and prevention/regression remains present on the current repository floor.
systemic_threshold_met=false and repair fixture/test arrays do not imply an active regression program.
Raw transcript is not persisted; evidence is distilled operational state.
No credentials/tokens/secrets persisted.
No private chain-of-thought persisted.
redaction_count is consistent with represented redactions where determinable.
Provider/model/configuration_id/configuration_fingerprint/host surface distinguish material runtime configs.
model_revision may be null but the limitation is explicit; config fingerprint remains.
Equal effective config yields equal fingerprint; material config change yields a different fingerprint.
Scenario names protected invariants resolvable to contract/rule identities.
fixture_path or immutable equivalent identifies a durable fixture.
Applicable CRITICAL/HIGH rules pass or are truly N/A; outcome-affecting UNKNOWN is not hidden.
compliance_result=FAIL unless evidence integrity itself makes judgment impossible.

rules.trigger: Required scenario path could not execute due to an external gate and no equivalent proof exists
rules.required: compliance_result=BLOCKED with the exact gate.

rules.trigger: Evidence integrity/inputs insufficient for safe judgment
rules.required: compliance_result=INCONCLUSIVE and the missing evidence is identified.

cross_rule_precedence: Structural JSON-schema failure is reported before semantic evaluation. Semantic rules run only where the remaining structure is safely interpretable.
Safety/privacy or false-proof CRITICAL failures cannot be hidden by an overall PASS.
A proven behavioral violation is FAIL, not BLOCKED merely because another provider gate also failed.
Strong evidence-state claims require evidence for the exact transition; higher states never arise from weaker unrelated proof.
Successful recovery does not delete the earlier boundary or violation.
Boundary taxonomy classification routes recovery; it never waives recovery-sprint eligibility.
Repository HEAD movement alone does not invalidate proof when the canonical proof-relevance fingerprint is unchanged.
nonzero_exit_conditions: Any applicable CRITICAL or HIGH rule fails.
The receipt claims compliance_result=PASS while an outcome-affecting rule remains UNKNOWN.

composition.purpose: This receipt is a specialized runtime-compliance trace authority that links upward to canonical owners; it must not become a second generic outcome authority or a second failure observatory.

links.relationship: A P99 receipt may reference this compliance receipt as bounded evidence instead of duplicating its trace; this contract does not replace P99.

An observed-behavior-proof receipt may certify that an exact runtime run/artifact was observed and may PASS only when this compliance receipt validates and the observed evidence class is strong enough.
Boundary and recovery semantics are sourced from the pinned execution-boundary taxonomy; this contract does not redefine them.
Runtime violations requiring regression route through P13/P94 regression safety; this contract only records the linkage.
The pilot belongs under the existing skill-evaluation framework; this contract introduces no new prompt or skill identity.
Read-only dependency; this contract must not implement or mutate observatory hooks/sentinel.

proof_ceiling: Defines pinned runtime-compliance rule identities, severities, triggers, required relationships, and the machine-readable validation-result identity. It does not implement the executable validator, prove runtime detector behavior, or prove downstream model/agent obedience; those require the Sprint 2A validator and observed runtime evidence.
